zh.title: AI 数字员工接班，你会通过哪份报告？
zh.summary: 同一笔租金为什么会被判成两个结果？12 次对照、1 次缺件测试和两张工单的续验，追查数字员工换班时该用哪版规程、该重做哪一步。

en.title: An AI worker takes over. Which rent report would you approve?
en.summary: Why do two reports on the same payment get opposite verdicts? Twelve comparisons, one missing-file check, and a paired follow-up trace which rules and evidence should survive an agent handoff.
